applies_to: Neptronic CMU compact make-up air units with electric heating, EC fan, damper and optional exhaust fan outputs.
summary: The CMU is a packaged make-up air heater with its own controller that exposes a fixed BACnet MS/TP object table. Objects are grouped into Integrator, Advanced and Factory lists, and MSV.2 Cfg_ObjectListMode selects which group the controller shows on the network. Points cover supply, room and outdoor air readings, airflow and temperature setpoints, damper and exhaust fan settings, and a long set of heater and sensor alarms.
notes: Each object belongs to the Integrator, Advanced or Factory list; descriptions mark the non-Integrator ones.
Which analog/binary inputs and outputs are used depends on the Cfg_ mode objects (MSV.3-MSV.10).
Several setpoint and output objects are commandable with a priority array.

source.title: Compact Make-up Air Unit BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Start/stop the unit with BV.18 SystemOnOff, choose where the temperature setpoint comes from with MSV.17 (set Network to use AV.10), and command the fan through AV.7 CurrentAirflowSetpoint. Monitor supply air temperature, occupancy state and the alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: SystemOnOff
minimum_points.why: Turns the unit on or off

minimum_points.name: Cfg_TempSetpointSource
minimum_points.why: Select OnBoard, Tstat or Network setpoint source

minimum_points.name: NetworkTempSetpoint
minimum_points.why: Temperature setpoint written by the BMS

minimum_points.name: CMUFanEnable
minimum_points.why: Shows whether the supply fan is enabled

integration.enable: BV.18 SystemOnOff turns the system on or off from the network. Occupancy can come from inputs (BV.13 enables them, BV.17 picks Unoccupied or Off when inactive) or from the internal schedule enabled by BV.11; without a schedule the unit stays occupied.
integration.remote_sensors: Set MSV.17 Cfg_TempSetpointSource to Network and write AV.10 NetworkTempSetpoint. MSV.16 selects whether control is on supply (SAT) or room (RAT) temperature; the doc lists no BMS-written temperature input.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; the device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC address (auto) and can be changed from the menu or by writing the Device Object_Identifier.
MAC address defaults to 0; baud rate auto-detects (9600/19200/38400/76800), or set it by writing Device proprietary property 1001.
Max_Master defaults to 127; lower it to the highest MAC on the trunk for faster token passing.
A Copy Config function in the menu can clone one controller's configuration to others of the same type on the trunk.
gotchas: Set MSV.2 Cfg_ObjectListMode to Advanced or Factory to see the objects outside the Integrator list.
AV.7, AV.13 and a few outputs are commandable; write at a consistent priority and relinquish when done.
BV.20 and BV.35 are internal communication alarms between the CMU main board and its add-on board, not BMS heartbeats.
Out_of_Service on read-only objects is writable for testing, but it reverts automatically after 15 minutes (Device proprietary property 1002, 0-120 min, 0 = never).
